strengths: Off-axis warm key, camera-side cool fill, and rear rim remain visually distinct in both old-city bookshop and contemporary gallery environments.
Neutral diffuse, matte cloth, glossy, metallic, structured wood, plaster, and portrait-form responses remain readable without clipped highlights.
The unrelated square gallery transfer preserves useful floor reflections, shadow modelling, and warm/cool spatial separation through camera movement.
All source and transfer camera, whole-frame exposure, subject-region exposure, and bounded adaptation checks pass.
limitations: The rig is accepted for warm interior key/fill/rim staging, not as a universal daylight, candlelight, firelight, or product-lighting solution.
The static witness establishes material and form response but does not establish final close-up skin shading or animated-character deformation quality.
Individual campaigns may still require bounded spatial and energy adaptation plus supplemental motivated practicals.
notes: Accepted after rejecting the mannequin-dependent probe, the cropped witness composition, the outside-set black render, the overly warm and flat v5 balance, and the first gallery transfer with its directional witness facing away from camera. The corrected v0.3/v7 bookshop and gallery evidence demonstrates a reusable, scoped production lighting asset rather than benchmark-only coordinates.
